sources.title: Neuenkirch, A conjecture on the optimal approximation of the fractional Lévy area
sources.version: EMS original OWR41/2012; complete contribution printed2524-2525

sources.title: Neuenkirch-Shalaiko, The maximum rate of convergence for the approximation of the fractional Lévy area at a single point
sources.version: Author text dated14July 2015, author-uploaded23July 2015; journal33(2016)107-117 metadata
sources.read: Complete author mathematical text online lines43-1680 through three opens; Theorem1, Remark5, Theorems2-3, conditional representation and full main proof.
sources.claim: For H>1/2 positive liminf and finite limsup at n^(1/2-2H); false increment-coercivity rough extension explicitly excluded.
sources.comparison: Exact smooth asymptotic prior. Actual journal full body not acquired or represented as inspected.

sources.title: Deya-Neuenkirch-Tindel, A Milstein-type scheme without Lévy area terms for SDEs driven by fractional Brownian motion

sources.comparison: Scheme upper/criterion result does not entail every estimator area lower rate.

sources.title: Huang, Optimal convergence rate of modified Milstein scheme for SDEs with rough fractional diffusions
